mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, member_email, profile_name, parent_type, profile_image_file_name, active, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_member_profile WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND active = TRUE

SELECT profile_id, member_email, profile_name, parent_type, profile_image_file_name, active, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_member_profile WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY reg_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_member_profile SET profile_name = #{profileName}, parent_type = #{parentType}, profile_image_file_name = #{profileImageFileName}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND member_email = #{memberEmail} AND active = TRUE
UPDATE tbl_member_profile SET active = FALSE, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
